precepts.text: Thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit, nor how the bones do grow in the womb; thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all. Science explains what God allows, then tries to outdo him by altering the body.
precepts.point: Pride is hateful before God and man. You can repent and hop back to the right side, but on the side of pride you are on the side God hates, and everything he hates has an expiration date.
precepts.why:
“As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit”: you don't know how the spirit was even made, and the body doesn't function without a spirit in it. We say someone is soulless, and it may be jacked up and crooked like the Esau in them, but that body isn't walking around with nothing in it. This is not a movie where they clone you and you come back with no soul, or a vampire who lives forever and can't see his reflection. There is a spirit in all of us, and the Most High made that.

“nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child”. Science tries to explain it the best way it can, by the mitochondria and this and that, but they don't know what God did to make it. Science is God giving man some sense of his mastery, and man takes it and says, I can do better than God: let me put this rod on you as a woman, let me cut yours off. That's why the Bible warns us to beware of science that opposes God.

“even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all.” So why is earth and ashes proud? Man does not even know how he himself was made; pride was not made for men.

“Flee also youthful lusts.” Youthful lust is not only in young men. A grown man in his forties, fifties or sixties can still have that youthful lust in him, and young men have it as well. “But follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.”

The point is to flee youthful lust. That is what Solomon spoke about in Ecclesiastes 11:9 and 10: young man, young woman, remove sorrow from your heart, because youthful lust leads to sorrow.

Solomon says “thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit, nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child.” Men call it the miracle of childbirth, the mystery of childbirth. They do not know how a child’s body is formed, how the bones are formed in the womb. We don’t understand that.

“Even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all.” What David was made in secret, in the lowest parts of the earth, is the work of God, and no man can explain it.

points: Walk in the ways of your own heart if that is what you want — just know God will bring you into judgment for all of it.
He says it to young men because a young man thinks he is invincible and his whole life is in front of him.
Childhood and youth are vanity. It is short, like a vapour; gather wisdom while you are in it.

Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth: God says, Rejoice in your youth. Yeah. Go ahead and live it up. You should do that. Your knees are good. Go ahead and run around and play with your friends. Your back ain't hurting yet. Enjoy your youth, young man.
and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth: Man, you can stay up late and you get two, three hours, you bounce right back. You full of energy. Enjoy that. Go ahead.
but know thou: But God warning you in your youth. You better remember this though.
that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment: God's going to judge you for everything that you do, even in your youth. So what does he tell you? How does he warn you?

Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart: You know what that sorrow is? Why I got to keep these commandments? Why I got to wear this? Why I got to obey this? Why I got to do this? Why we got to celebrate this? I want to go be with my friends of the world. God said, You better remove that sorrow from your heart. Remove it far from you.

for childhood and youth are vanity: That means God don't care about your age. If you disrespect your parents, and you are ungrateful, and you're not following their instruction, God will take you out of this world, even as a youth. You see it happening to these rappers who are dying at 20 years old, 21 years old, 19 years old, 16 years old. God does not care when you are disobedient to your parents and an ungrateful child.

and put away evil from thy flesh: Put evil away from your flesh. Don't be finding yourself in the midst of messing around with girls. You ain't supposed to do that. Marital affairs or sexual matters is made for a married man and a married woman. That's not made for you as a youth. You shouldn't be on drugs. That's not made for the body that God gave you. Remove all evil from thy flesh.
Cast your bread upon the waters, for you shall find it after many days; give a portion to seven and also to eight, for you know not what evil shall be upon the earth.

note.label: Ecclesiastes 11: Cast Thy Bread Upon the Waters

points: “Rejoice, O young man, in thy youth; and let thy heart cheer thee in the days of thy youth.” It goes for the young woman too. Solomon wrote this, and he is being very sarcastic; our forefathers were sarcastic and God is sarcastic. Yeah, young man, have fun, YOLO: “walk in the ways of thine heart, and in the sight of thine eyes”, whatever you see and want, take it. “But know thou, that for all these things God will bring thee into judgment.” You can do those things, but God will deal with you.

“Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh.” The sorrow is walking in the ways of your own heart and the sight of your own eyes, because that leads to destruction, damnation, consequences and repercussions.

“For childhood and youth are vanity.” You won’t stay young forever, and if you do something stupid enough in your youth, that youth goes fast. Youth means nothing in prison, nothing when your check is garnished and you walk out of court making ten dollars a week. A girl walking around fifteen or sixteen pregnant, her youth is over; and if she aborts it, the Most High will abort her.
